03 · Method

What these counts represent

Each row is a coded subject–verb occurrence. Coordinated predicates can contribute multiple rows. In passive clauses, the grammatical subject can be the affected participant. The chart’s percentage denominator is the number of coded occurrences for each outlet under the selected country and subject-type filters.

Material covers action and change, verbal covers communication, relational covers attribution and identification, mental covers cognition and perception, behavioural covers observable behaviour, and existential covers existence or occurrence.

The inventory is parser-assisted with concordance corrections. It covers explicit country-linked subjects and recovered shared subjects. Standalone city names and unlinked pronouns are outside its scope. Headlines and merged captions may contain missed or miscoded cases. The supplied samples differ in topic, dates, and format.
